observations: Blue plastic barrel/drum with a red screw-cap lid, photographed from two angles.
Embossed markings on the body read '210' and '10.2Kg' (likely liter capacity and empty weight).
Background shows a yard stacked with other used black and green drums, suggesting a drum resale/recycling yard.
Semi-transparent text overlays read 'STAN HARMLESS RESOURCES' and 'FRANKTECH GLOBAL SERVICES' - these are watermark branding, not a product label.
No photo shows the drum's interior, so cleanliness or prior contents cannot be judged.
No close-up of the base or seams to check for cracks, warping, or leaks.

claims.claim: Empty plastic water drum for water
claims.evidence: Lid is closed and sealed with cap in both photos; interior is not visible, so 'empty' and 'for water' (food-safe/clean) cannot be confirmed from the images.

risks.risk: Drum may have previously held non-water substances (chemicals, oil, etc.), affecting safety for water storage.
risks.proof: A photo or clip of the open lid showing the clean interior, plus any original content label if present.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a general-purpose used drum of unverified food-grade cleanliness, not as a dedicated clean water drum

risks.risk: Structural damage: cracks, dents, or a warped base that could cause leaks.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base, seams, and a shot of the drum holding water or at least standing upright unassisted on a flat surface.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst case, assuming possible minor damage typical of a yard-stored used drum

risks.risk: Cap/lid seal may not close tightly, allowing leaks or contamination.
risks.proof: A photo or short clip showing the cap being twisted on/off and sealing fully.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having an unverified/possibly imperfect seal

risks.risk: Actual capacity may differ from the embossed '210' figure if it refers to something other than liters.
risks.proof: A clearer photo of the full embossed capacity text, unobstructed by watermark.
risks.if_unproven: priced using the visible '210' as an approximate nominal liter capacity, unconfirmed

proof_requests: Photo of the open drum showing a clean, empty interior
Close-up photo of the base and any seams for cracks or dents
Clip showing the cap sealing and the drum being lifted/tilted without leaking
Clearer, unobstructed photo of the full capacity embossing
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable by type as a used plastic water drum of roughly 210L capacity; interior condition and structural integrity are unverified so it is priced at worst case pending the listed proofs.
